turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: That’s an intriguing idea! While hearing and speaking are certainly related, they are actually quite different processes. Hearing is about perceiving sound, while speaking involves producing sound. They do share some neural pathways, especially in the brain areas involved in language processing, but they are distinct functions. Your professor might have been referring to how both processes are crucial for effective communication.
